actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Seed of the environment's random generator
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

inputs.description: Seed used by the next reset
inputs.name: seed

facts.text: DescentEnv-v0 is registered with entry point bluesky_gym.envs.descent_env:DescentEnv and max_episode_steps=300
DescentEnv is a gymnasium.Env subclass
The action space is a Box from -1 to 1 with shape (1,)
The observation space is a Dict of altitude, vz, target_altitude and runway_distance, each a Box from -inf to +inf
ACTION_2_MS is 12.5
_get_action multiplies the action by ACTION_2_MS and its comment says the result is metres per second
A non-negative action sets the target altitude to 1000000 (a climb command) and a negative action sets it to 0 (a descent command) before setting the selected vertical speed
The environment sends BlueSky the stack command 'DT 1;FF'
ACTION_FREQUENCY is 30
step calls bs.sim.step() ACTION_FREQUENCY times before it reads the observation
A reset draws the initial altitude with np.random.randint(ALT_MIN, ALT_MAX) and the target altitude as that altitude plus np.random.randint(-TARGET_ALT_DIF, TARGET_ALT_DIF)
ALT_MIN is 2000, ALT_MAX is 4000 and TARGET_ALT_DIF is 500
A reset creates KL001 as an A320 at the drawn altitude with speed AC_SPD and switches VNAV off
AC_SPD is 150
The observation normalisation constants are ALT_MEAN 1500, ALT_STD 3000, VZ_MEAN 0, VZ_STD 5, RWY_DIS_MEAN 100 and RWY_DIS_STD 200
The observation divides (altitude - ALT_MEAN) by ALT_STD, (vz - VZ_MEAN) by VZ_STD, (target_altitude - ALT_MEAN) by ALT_STD and (runway_distance - RWY_DIS_MEAN) by RWY_DIS_STD
runway_distance is DEFAULT_RWY_DIS (200) minus the great-circle distance from 52N 4E to the aircraft times NM2KM (1.852)

The reward is abs(target_altitude - altitude) * ALT_DIF_REWARD_SCALE while the runway is ahead and the altitude is positive, CRASH_PENALTY when the altitude is zero or below, and altitude * RWY_ALT_DIF_REWARD_SCALE when the runway is reached
ALT_DIF_REWARD_SCALE is -5/3000, CRASH_PENALTY is -100 and RWY_ALT_DIF_REWARD_SCALE is -50/3000
A terminated step deletes every aircraft from the BlueSky traffic
close sends 'quit' to the BlueSky stack

determinism.notes: reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 fixes the initial altitude and the target altitude; this package's fake then integrates its deterministic analytic descent.  Upstream draws those two values with numpy's generator and integrates BlueSky's aircraft performance model, so one seed gives different trajectories on the two implementations

gaps: kinematic/analytic model: no forces, contacts, aircraft performance, actuator, sensor or noise model; the fake moves the altitude by the commanded vertical speed and closes the runway distance at a placeholder rate

one cap.world.step.v1 tick applies one action and then runs ACTION_FREQUENCY=30 BlueSky simulation steps at the environment's DT 1 setting (descent_env.py:29 and :71); timestep_ms is the 30-step per-tick period, and the clone states no unit for DT
the fake draws the reset altitude and target with Python's random.Random; upstream uses numpy's generator, so one seed gives different initial states

the fake's initial runway distance and closure rate are placeholders, not the BlueSky aircraft position and ground speed; upstream computes runway_distance from the great-circle distance to 52N 4E (descent_env.py:94-101)
the fake does not render the rgb_array or human frames the environment declares (descent_env.py:45)
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state
no physical device is modelled and the model was never validated against one
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, and a tick advances simulated time by 30000 ms only

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: after an e-stop the runtime refuses step and reset until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, and the last world state stays readable
